_comment: The federation-shared market vocabulary. Need-shaped: each category answers 'what human need does this serve?'. `id` is the wire value offerings carry (lowercase snake_case; the relay validates membership at ingest), `label` is what UIs display, `desc` seeds tooltips and empty states. UIs prepend their own catch-all 'All' filter row; it is not a category.

categories.label: Food
categories.desc: Meals, groceries, produce, preserved food, food pantries

categories.label: Water
categories.desc: Drinking water, filtration, purification, wells, rain catchment

categories.label: Shelter
categories.desc: Housing, rooms, roofing and weatherproofing, camping and emergency shelter

categories.label: Energy
categories.desc: Power, fuel, solar, batteries, generators, heating and cooling

categories.label: Health
categories.desc: Medical care, medicine, first aid, dental, vision, mental health

categories.label: Clothing
categories.desc: Clothes, shoes, textiles, sewing and mending

categories.label: Tools
categories.desc: Hand tools, power tools, equipment to borrow or own

categories.label: Materials
categories.desc: Building materials, parts, fasteners, raw stock

categories.label: Repair
categories.desc: Fixing what exists: appliances, electronics, homes, machines

categories.label: Transport
categories.desc: Rides, delivery, moving help, vehicles and their upkeep

categories.label: Growing
